# weapons

A ship weapon. A beam is fully described by its record (damage pair, mods, space and cost). Missiles, torpedoes, fighters and special weapons also need rows in the combat rules.

A mod adds records in `records/weapons/<file>.json` (`{ "$schema": "carina-records/1", "catalog": "weapons", "records": [...] }`) and changes base records with patch rows on catalog `weapons`. Schema: [weapons records schema](../schemas/records/weapons.schema.json).

## Fields

A mod record leaves out `id` and `prov`: the game assigns ids, and `prov` is the project's own provenance.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | `<namespace>.<snake_case>`: your package id with `-` read as `_`, then a name | yes |  |
| `application` | key of a record in `applications`, or null | yes | the key of the application that unlocks it |
| `class` | one of `beam`, `missile`, `torpedo`, `bomb`, `fighter`, `special` | yes |  |
| `ammo` | integer >= 0 or null | yes |  |
| `space` | integer >= 0 | yes | ship space per mount |
| `cost` | integer >= 0 | yes | production cost per mount |
| `damage` | [integer >= 0, integer >= 0] | yes | [minimum, maximum] damage in tactical combat |
| `strategicDamage` | [integer >= 0, integer >= 0] | yes | [minimum, maximum] damage in strategic (auto-resolve) combat |
| `mods` | list of snake_case keys (no repeats) | yes | weapon-mod keys the weapon may carry |
| `inherentBits` | integer 0..65535 | yes |  |
| `monster` | true or false | yes | false for every player weapon |
| `nameKey` | text key | yes |  |

References to other records are written as keys; the game turns them into ids.

## Also register it in

- missile: [combat-rules](rules-combat-rules.md) `fliers.missile.types` (append `{ weapon, hp, bd }`)
- torpedo: [combat-rules](rules-combat-rules.md) `fliers.torpedo.types`
- fighter: [combat-rules](rules-combat-rules.md) `fliers.fighter.types` and [ship-design](rules-ship-design.md) `auto.fighters`
- special weapon: [combat-rules](rules-combat-rules.md) `specialWeapons.weapons` with one of the existing `kind`s, and [ship-design](rules-ship-design.md) `auto.specialWeapons`

## Computer players

Beams: the ship designer picks the beam with the highest maximum damage, and the combat AI fires it by class. Missiles, torpedoes and fighters are used once their combat-rules and ship-design rows exist. A special weapon is used only through the existing kinds.

## Limits

- `class` is one of beam, missile, torpedo, bomb, fighter, special; no new classes.
- New special weapon kinds need code.
- Weapon mods (`mods`) come from the weapon-mods catalog, which is closed.
- A missile, torpedo, fighter or special weapon without its combat-rules row is refused (`weapon-without-combat-row`).
- The design screens show `<nameKey>` with `.name` replaced by `.plural` and `.note`: the mod's English text needs both. The `.note` has room for about 35 characters in the weapon list; a longer note is cut off with an ellipsis.

## Patch paths

Rows on this catalog address a record by `key` and a field by `path`:

- `set`: `ammo`, `application`, `class`, `cost`, `damage`, `inherentBits`, `mods`, `monster`, `nameKey`, `space`, `strategicDamage`
- `append`, `insertAfter`, `removeValue`: `mods`
